* Using a language model trained from scratch on a large Twitter based corpus, and fine-tuning it with a small dataset of labeled tweets, achieves a high performance on a Spanish Twitter Humor Classification task.
* We used a language model trained on a large Twitter corpus to improve our humor prediction performance.
* We used a large Spanish corpus of 1.5B tokens to train a language modeling system.

the application of language models to humor detection, and the use of a pre-trained model to improve classification and regression performance.
the development and evaluation of a system that predicts the humor of a given text.
the application of pre-trained language models to humor detection on Twitter, with an emphasis on Spanish.
